claims.statement: On a fixed finite rational graph with positive weights, Phi1 is weighted L1 distance of edge claims from graph coboundaries. The example triangle has quotient minimum three; a gauge change preserves its oriented cycle sum.
claims.limits: Conditional finite graph mathematics; enumeration can be combinatorial. No domain-adapter or model-efficacy result.

claims.statement: Replacing edge claims by a computed coboundary makes their quotient obstruction zero. Gauge-changing a section alone cannot remove a nonzero cycle obstruction.
claims.limits: The replacement changes the instance. Its acceptability depends on independently declared allowed repairs.

findings.statement: The streaming wrapper fraction-converts initial float/Boolean values, silently overwrites conflicting spellings of the same edge, and accepts repeated JSON keys with last-value semantics. These transformations occur before the stricter governor guard.
A CUT with unrelated schema, nonexistent parent and invented expected delta is admitted when its normalized claims pass. The wrapper does not implement the scaffold's chain/surface contract.
Initialization appends an ASSERT-shaped trace row for an undeclared edge while discarding the refused verdict. The empty admitted state then has zero obstruction.

Graph construction permits Boolean/float weights and section operations coerce them, while primary minimization rejects these types. The same declared graph can pass earlier paths and fail later evaluation.
Two assertions can reuse a snapshot ID; retracting that ID selects the earlier snapshot. IDs do not uniquely identify a public history state.

With in-memory run_turn replaced by refused verification outcomes, receipt summary still says PASS_ALL_INVARIANTS and retains terminal success labels. This reproduces a summary-construction defect, not an actual provider/native failure.
An injected inconsistent second projection makes the quickstart print VIOLATED while still printing CERTIFIED_EXACT_RATIONAL and exiting zero. Certification status must depend on checks.

The live adapter has no output-token cap or whole-run monetary reservation, discards usage, and ignores an empty SSE delta carrying finish_reason length. In-memory URL stubs reproduced this without network or credentials.

Four labelled bouts prove only facts about supplied finite graph cochains. They do not implement MUB, lock, AST or market semantics; baseline costs are explicitly hypothetical and antibody counts are hardcoded. Preserve the finite exercise and exclude these labels from measured efficacy.
findings.validation: complete source reading; additional controls pending

findings.statement: The deadlock fixture records candidate cost one and intermediate obstruction one, but replacing the weight-one claim from one to minus three costs four in the stated weighted L1 metric. The intermediate one is a literal, not an executed state measurement.

Toolkit SURVIVOR_OBSTRUCTION can result from max_cuts zero or a refusal and does not certify irreducibility. Its projection replacement repairs the graph instance by changing claims; it does not solve the original fixed assertions.

Actual Python execution admits the alleged bogus zeroing and reduces quotient nine to zero, yet the cemetery records REFUSED_OBSTRUCTION_TAO_WITNESS and prints a minted pre-call antibody. The graph checker does not enforce the alleged immutable polynomial witness.

Actual Python execution ends at quotient four and fails ZERO_OBSTRUCTION, but the cemetery records ACCEPTED_TERMINAL with zero danger and says the graph was repaired to zero. The displayed candidate text also differs from the claim map evaluated in the earlier refusal.
validate_bout_trace accepts an empty trace and an unknown move under an invented domain ID. It imposes no required sequence or completeness and is not an independent trace verifier.

The metadata abstract says no external deposit or DOI is claimed, while the same JSON supplies DOI/record fields and notes saying published October 3. Preserve historical versions and state which status belongs to which edition; endpoint inaccessibility alone proves nothing about publication.

The cross-domain receipt is LF-equivalent to its archive and all eight entry hashes still verify. Preserve the original and label a renamed copy as a derived transcription.
